title: The goose that laid the golden eggs.
lines: Once upon a time there was a farmer and his wife.
They lived on a little farm with a thatched roof.
They had a cow, a few hens and one goose.
A white goose with an orange beak.
One morning the farmer went to the goose's nest.
He wanted to get an egg for breakfast.
There was an egg in the nest.
But it wasn't an ordinary egg.
The farmer couldn't believe his eyes.
They took the egg to the market.
They got lots and lots of money for it.
The next morning there was another golden egg.
And the morning after that too.
Every day the goose laid one golden egg.
The farmer and his wife became rich.
One egg a day is too few, he said.
His wife said: Don't we have enough?
Be happy with what we have.
He thought: There must be lots more golden eggs inside the goose.
He wanted to open up the goose to get all the gold at once.
She flapped her wings and flew out of the nest.
The next morning the farmer went to the nest.
The farmer sat down on the step.
His wife sat down next to him.
We had a golden egg every day, she said.
I should have been happy with what I had.
And far away, by the river, a white goose laid a golden egg every morning.
